title: Aspiring writer-director here. I’ve got a question.

commenti.body:
Heya, part of my professional background is developing film and television.

1) Not going to touch it unless you have some authority or personal story to tell about the character with ASD. You'll get a polite, "intriguing" with a, "we feel this is too similar to some other projects we're working on" a week later.

2) Sounds like R-rated Ready Player One. Anyone interested in that concept is probably already trying to get themselves in line for the rights to *Snowcrash*.

3) This is a TV show pitch, or at least would be stronger as one. 

You're best bet is to pick your favorite concept and write the spec. Writers get good at writing by writing.
